hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market YES/NO pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) dynamic fees. Requires a backend-signed sigma value in hookData for every swap; captures fees via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and distributes them to share token holders through a YieldDistributor. Blocks swaps and liquidity operations when the market is resolved or disputed.
